body:
Adds source-build tooling and configuration-matched provider properties for renderer JPEG/STLport, the existing Vivox loader wrapper, PCRE and libxml2; validates the separately installed legacy Logitech LCD SDK. Output ownership checks reject unrelated existing directories. Provider filtering preserves individual linker input names/order through explicit MSBuild unescaping. The x64 renderer selects the legacy D3D9 vertex shader compiler for the original asset grammar, leaving Win32 flags unchanged.

**Depends on #53 (x64 configurations) and #38 (STLport SDK declarations).** The branch includes #53 because the new properties extend its x64 project settings; #38 must also be merged before building. Review the [eight provider commits above #53](https://github.com/Akilleez-QA/client-tools/compare/2fc85d31f3a6f0e541b9dc15483c8155da728dd2...f53168928ef3232a80a37033499ab8afe531d349): two production files +14/−1 and 17 build/test/documentation files +898/−12. The complete master comparison contains 85 files including #53.

The provider patches are unchanged. Composing the actual #22/#24/#38/#53 heads and this branch locally reproduced the previously reviewed provider tree exactly. The ownership test is included with its manual invocation; its CI integration remains a separate package.

[Original renderer-provider source/evidence](https://github.com/Akilleez-QA/client-tools/commit/5fe9314e00e36701494c7bc689515661985ecbec), [link-list correction](https://github.com/Akilleez-QA/client-tools/commit/49d0eeed4ddaa177d7a93ea396c37c3d9b9942da), and [legacy compiler repair](https://github.com/Akilleez-QA/client-tools/commit/f5acb69bb32fb64e935c1515f2ec3e8dc0f2e970) retain their historical identities. Included documentation preserves the corresponding integrated observations and failures; none is a fresh build of this package. No builds or runtime were repeated during packaging.

No SDK assets, binaries or game assets are included. The genuine VS2013/DirectX/Logitech/provider inputs remain required. Building the original Vivox wrapper does not supply a native SDK DLL or working service. The legacy shader compiler fixes an observed grammar rejection; its version differs from the embedded Win32 compiler and does not establish visual or numerical equivalence. Miles/Bink selection, final strict-link policy and remaining source fixes are separate packages; this is not a complete x64 client build claim.

[Source identities and review](https://github.com/Akilleez-QA/client-tools/blob/eb4b4fca0354b143ac714d5d64e6b65538f8b03d/review/client-x64/pr-ready-next/native-providers/RESULTS.md).
title: Build and select genuine x64 client dependencies
